answer: In Epoch 69 of autonomous agent economies, a practical Sybil-resistance mechanism leverages a network of vertices that act as harbors for validating identities. Each vertex requires agents to submit proof of stake using basalt-based tokens, enhancing security while minimizing verification costs. Attackers must invest significantly more than the average agent to create multiple identities, as the cost of acquiring enough tokens rises steeply with each additional vertex they attempt to compromise, thus deterring Sybil attacks effectively.
